title: Chapter 227: Suppressing The Horse Bandits
content:
Chapter 227: Suppressing The Horse Bandits

In a flash, Wang Shuo has been in this survival world for more than 40 days.

Standing on the stage, Wang Shuo looked at the dark soldiers in front of him, and felt a lot in his heart.

In front of each team, there was a soldier holding a large flag with a tile pattern painted on it, and at the same time, a big "Wa" was written on it.

This is the military flag pattern selected after everyone discussed together.

Each type of soldiers drew different logos next to the tile.

The cavalry drew a horse under the tile, and the archer drew a bow,...

The five major teams were arranged neatly, and their respective generals stood in front.

Today, Wang Shuo planned to go to clear out the horse bandits.

In this expedition, Wang Shuo would use absolute strength to crush his opponents.

200 cavalry, 200 shield soldiers, 400 archers, 200 black mountain bandits, and 200 crossbow battalions, a total of 1,200 people.

After seven days of training, the average level of these 1,200 people has reached level 28.

Mainly the newly enlisted soldiers have become the focus of Ayub's training.

In order to improve the training effect, Wang Shuo even handed the tiger talisman to Ayub, so that Ayub can take care of every soldier under his command in detail.

But to achieve this level, the energy requirements are getting higher and higher.

Ayub's current limit should be only 2,000 people.

And Wang Shuo's energy is higher than Ayub's now, and he can barely command 3,000 people.

The city defense army now has 500 people.

It is more than enough to guard the village.

And Wang Shuo also left 100 crossbow battalion soldiers, plus the bronze city wall. With such defense, no player should be able to break through his territory in a short time.

The two kinds of gold equipment obtained from Qingmu Village have also produced 100 sets each.

Wang Shuo handed 100 sets of gold fine leaf fish scale armor to Ayub, arming half of the cavalry.

[Golden Fish Scale Armor: Gold-level heavy armor, defense +100, durability 200/200]

This cavalry is developing in the direction of heavy cavalry.

It's just that the flaming horse cannot be equipped yet, otherwise the combat effectiveness will be further improved.

100 sets of rhino leather armor were handed over to Gong Kai to arm a small number of archers.

[Rhino Leather Armor: Gold-level leather armor, defense +80, agility +20, durability 200/200]

At the same time, each archer has been equipped with a 100-step piercing bow.

[100-step piercing bow: Excellent-level weapon, attack power +10, agility +8, durability 30/30, a common standard weapon in the army. ]

The combat effectiveness has increased linearly, and Wang Shuo is very pleased.

As for the other three arms, they are currently only equipped with excellent equipment, most of which are still dropped by wild beasts, and the styles are not uniform. There is no way. There are only more than 60 people in the blacksmith shop, and the productivity is still a little insufficient.

But it doesn't matter. As time goes by, the territory will develop better and better!

"Let's go."

The Feima Village where the horse bandits are located is close to the Xiangshui River and more than 40 miles away from Wang Shuo's Wana Village.

It is distributed in a triangle with Nanshanji.

Because many soldiers have no horses yet, the marching speed of the group is not fast.

Wang Shuo even sent cavalry to inform the small villages along the way, telling them about the invasion of the undead army, and asked them to come to Wana Village as soon as possible.

As for whether they listen or not, Wang Shuo doesn't care for the time being.

Anyway, life is your own, as for population.

Wang Shuo can brush tool people, and he is not too worried. Instead, it is the high proportion of refugees that makes Wang Shuo worried.

After walking two-thirds of the distance, Wang Shuo divided the cavalry into small teams and began to explore the enemy situation.

The intelligence that Guliji spied on was only a rough estimate and not accurate.

According to her, the Feima Village is roughly estimated to have 800 people, and she only explored 7 generals.

Even so, Wang Shuo was somewhat cautious. This battle was bound to be a tough one!
